headline: Approved a retirement application for Jennifer Lynn Blow and return of contributions for Kadeem R. Noel and Matthew P. Deforge.
summary: Members approved the September 28, 2026 minutes, return of contributions for two members, and a retirement application. The meeting also included presentations on an actuarial valuation report and a quarterly investment review, plus an information item on a prepaid pension repayment to the City.
decisions: Approved the September 28, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, unanimously.
Approved return of contributions for Kadeem R. Noel ($4,158.38) and Matthew P. Deforge ($11,125.13), unanimously.
Approved the retirement application for Jennifer Lynn Blow, Class B $3,060.38, effective 09/01/26, payment date 10/15/26, unanimously.
